# QR encoder for desktop invitations

Unmodified C# sources from [Codecrete QR Code Generator](https://github.com/manuelbl/QrCodeGenerator), release **v2.1.0**, commit `d75ad20b2f2c04a41120c3e7c7326842fc837fcc`. MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt` and source headers. This release targets .NET Standard 2.0 and needs no external graphics library.

Used to render the standard room invitation in Windows/editor players. Android QR generation and camera recognition use Huawei Scan Kit. The encoder is not represented as an HMS integration.
